title: Partition Labels
statement_md:
You are given a string `s`. We want to partition the string into as many parts as possible so that each letter appears in at most one part.

Return *a list of integers representing the size of these parts*.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Record the last index of every character first. Then expand the boundary until the current index reaches the furthest needed index.
editorial_md:
### Method: Greedy Last-Index Intervals
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(1)$ (26 characters)
